name: files4testing compression test vectors
description: Decompress each entry's path and assert sha256(output bytes) == expected_sha256. Archive formats (7z/zip/rar/tar/iso and tar+compressor variants) contain files named like the raw file; stream formats decompress to the raw byte stream directly. Entries with `expected_files`/`tree_sha256` produce a multi-file tree: extract all members and assert each file's sha256 plus the whole-tree hash (tree_sha256 = sha256 over sorted `path\0+bytes` concatenation). cso entries decompress to an ISO byte stream (see expected_file, the matching .iso).
